newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Coca-Cola FEMSA started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Coca-Cola FEMSA started.

text.p: -- ING Barings said analyst Marla Marron had started coverage of Mexican bottler Coca-Cola FEMSA SA with a rating of buy.
-- "We forecast a five-six percent volume rebound in the Mexican and Argentine soft drink markets in 1997," Marron wrote in a March 11 report.
-- Pricing in Argentina has begun to improve and the company should "garner economies of scale from the addition of a new territory in 1998," she said.
-- She set a 12-month price target for the stock of $42.
-- American Depositary Receipts in the company closed Tuesday at 35-5/8.
